name: yf_shares_outstanding
description:
Shares outstanding over time for one company from Yahoo Finance (yfinance get_shares_full, about the last 18 months).
Returns: {symbol, shares: [{index (date-time), 0 (share count)}]}, oldest first, at most 100 rows.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
Current count only: yf_fast_info (shares_outstanding); float and short interest: openbb_equity_share_statistics. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
